title: The P6 acceptance suite could not fail by exit code, and a core report caveat rested on a mis-targeted run
what_went_wrong: p6_acceptance_suite.sh ended with an echo and no exit on FAIL, so the wrapper reported 'suite exit=0' regardless of results; '18/18' rested only on printed counts.

stage_restore returned True when the pre-reset hash file was missing (fail-open); three_count's exit expression returned 1 for the documented exit-0 PARTIAL case; --verify-form-save was parsed and ignored.

R5 stated in three places that the headless form writes the verification layer, not billing. An audited form run shows Khanza's save writes billing. The claim likely came from P1 clone-mode runs whose form actually ran on live sik (database.ini mis-target), where already-paid visits were not saved.
root_cause: Exit codes and return values were reported as evidence without a test that the failure path can trigger; a structural claim was derived from an observation on a target whose identity had not been verified.
detection: Astra v6 (gpt-6-astra run 4818826) source read; each claim re-verified against the code by the orchestrator on 2026-10-17 before fixing.

correction.code: Suite exits non-zero on any FAIL (A14 self-test); restore without a hash fails closed (A15); three_count exit contract fixed and --verify-form-save enforced (contract test 4/4); exact integer tax; live sik checksums + --allow-live guard (A13/A16).
correction.report: R5 §0/§1/§13 B-subset statements struck through and annotated; §18 added.
correction.verification: Suite 21/21 on a fresh fixture (evidence/p7/r5_p6_acceptance_20261016T195113Z.md); audited provenance run (evidence/p7/r5_p7_write_provenance_*.md).

rule: Every gate or suite whose result is cited must have a demonstrated failing case for its exit code; a structural claim about what a system writes must come from an audit on a verified target.
